reason: I get web people cold-messaging me every month, and this lot are in Kuwait with no UK office and not one client I can ring or a review I can read. Pay-when-happy is clever, but my time is the real cost, and I'm not spending hours on video calls chasing someone abroad if it goes sideways.
objection: Who looks after it once it's live? If something breaks on a busy Saturday, I'd be WhatsApping someone in a different time zone, and I'd bet the 'optional' £325 a month turns into something I'm pushed into.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real UK small businesses like mine that they've built for, which I could actually look at and ring, plus a clear fixed yearly price for hosting and looking after it so I know there's no surprise monthly bill.
